finding: Terminal expert-score updates are resolution-inventoried through active discovery plus open positions, not through the full unresolved forecast set. Non-position forecasts can therefore remain unscored after closure, and forecast_state stores no timestamp or time-to-resolution horizon.

deterministic_fixture.description: Two forecasted markets close after leaving active discovery. Only one has an open position. The position-selected incumbent lookup scores only that market; a forecast-inventory lookup scores both.
deterministic_fixture.interpretation: The Brier difference is an illustrative deterministic selection-bias counterexample, not an estimate of live calibration error.

required_next_experiment: persist unresolved forecasts independently of positions with forecast timestamp and time-to-resolution bucket
backfill terminal outcomes for every matured forecast using read-only Gamma resolution lookup
score all forecast origins, not only the last forecast before closure
fit calibration mappings only on prior resolved forecasts with event/time clustering
compare uncalibrated versus horizon-calibrated probabilities on common chronological rows using Brier, log-loss and calibration error
for trading decisions, compare executable OOS net PnL at 1x, 1.5x and 2x costs plus drawdown and turnover
do not integrate a production calibration change until enough independent resolved events exist
